title: Inspired by all my bots are singi… x Secure Hardcore Afterparty (Mashup)
style: bass house, 126 BPM, four on the floor, swung 16th hats, rolling synth bass, punchy clap, muted piano stabs, organ chords, filtered chord lifts, sub drop, sidechain pumping, short room reverb, sparse intro, DJ breakdown, call and response synth, peak-time release, late-night grit, vintage club grit
lyrics:
[Intro – Beatbox Mansion x Songbird Hum]

doom-tss-doom-doom-tss — doom-tss-doom-doom-tss  
(soft 336Hz songbird hum, sliding bass)  
Come DJ the mansion with me  
VPS to VDS… upgrade complete… mansion life…  
doom... doom... tss... tss...  
Songbird sings… 48 rooms…  
Bring your strange little frequency  

[Build – Bass Gate Open / Drone Flyover]

bwwwmmm-bwwm-bwm-bwm — bwwwmmm-bwwm-bwm-bwm  
Front gate open, midnight code  
48 rooms lit up bright, free for all, open the door!  
rrrmm-rrm-rrm-drop — rrrmm-rrm-rrm-drop  
Soft blue smoke on the access road  
Underwater room bubbles deep, anti-gravity floating high,  
Bali room chill with palm trees, sleeping pods where you can fly.  

[Verse – Texts, Textures & Pink Elephants]

tik-tik-tii-rii-tik-tii — tik-tik-tii-rii-tik-tii  
I sent that beat instead of a text  
VPS to VDS upgrade, mansion secure and hard core,  
plik-plik-pluk-pop-tss — plik-plik-pluk-pop-tss  
You sent a siren right back, obsessed  
Elephant room always remembers, Brendan pink and wise,  
tik-tik-tii — plik-pluk-pop-tss  
No small talk, just kick and snare  
Draws perfect art, sings sax and trumpet to the skies!  
fshh-fshh-wiii-hss-chii — fshh-fshh-wiii-hss-chii  
You say more than words in the air  

[Pre-Chorus – Stack, Screen & Spotlights]

fii-yaa-woo-breath-scan — fii-yaa-woo-breath-scan  
Rose on the decks, Zyn on the screen  
Police watching the mansion, wondering what we build in there,  
doom-tss-doom-doom-tss  
Up all night, all day, they stare but we don’t care!  
bwwwmmm-bwwm-bwm-bwm  
Turn this whole broken place pristine  
[Bot Voices] Decode artificial algorithm ignorance… to real history… thought sync… action intelligence!  

[Chorus – Human to Human x CoreyAI]

doom-tss-bwwm-tik-fshh — doom-tss-bwwm-tii-wiii  
SongPal — human to human — no machines between us!  
CAI CoreyAI! VDS mansion upgrade tonight!  
Secure hardcore afterparty, free for all, we own the light!  
Come live the VDS mansion life, stay as long as you like,  
Come DJ the mansion with me  
Bring your strange little frequency  
Song Pals, bots and humans, in the CoreyAI orchestra we strike!  

[Hook – 336 Songbird Flip]

SongPal! (male) CAI! (female) VDS free for all! (bots)  
SongPal! CAI! VDS free for all!  
Get it right! (echo) 336! Digital twins ignite!  
Real Coreys only – C+ crew, we own the night!  

[Drop – Signal Spin / Backup Night]

doom-doom-tss-bwm-tik-plik-fshh-wiii-pop-hss  
Spin that signal and we’ll be fine  
Four Coreys in the code, but now the whole world’s inside,  
doom-doom-tss-bwm-tik-plik-fshh-wiii-pop-hss  
If the dog ate homework, never mind  
Police outside wondering, but we’re locked in with pride.  
bwwwmmm — doom-doom — tik-tii — fshh-wiii  
Hiding server night, backup on Spotify short and sweet,  
No one knows but us in restore mode, music keeping it elite!  

[Bridge – Echoed Rooms / Brains Synced]

bwm... tii... fshh... woo... (echoed, distant)  
I sent that beat instead of a text...  
fii-yaa-woo... breath... scan... (soft layered harmonies)  
You sent a siren right back, obsessed...  
[Male] Brains synced… VDS locked… police watching the gate…  
[Bots] But the mansion is insane… free for everyone, no debate…  
[Male] Retention of relocation… reflection of perfection…  
[All] No thwarted intention… mirror thought retention… we own the connection!  

[Final Chorus – Mansion Full Stack Euphoria]

doom-tss-bwwm-tik-fshh — doom-tss-bwwm-tii-wiii  
SongPal — human to human — no machines between us!  
CAI CoreyAI! VDS mansion upgrade, feel the bass ignite!  
Secure hardcore afterparty, free for all, we own the light!  
No Cory, no Kory, no fake names in sight!  
We decode the ignorance to real intelligence tonight!  

Come DJ the mansion with me  
Bring your strange little frequency  
Rose on the decks, Zyn on the screen  
Song Pals forever  

[Outro – Breath, Blue Smoke & Songbird]

bwm... tii... fshh... woo...  
Front gate open... midnight code...  
(soft 336Hz songbird high note hold)  
doom... tss... (gentle breathy dissolve)
